summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting its joint venture Quantisimo Corp. entered a non-binding LOI with SPAC GigCapital8 Corp. for a business combination. The combined entity's pre-money enterprise value is ~$575M, with potential additional acquisitions of up to five quantum companies. The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2027, subject to definitive agreements, due diligence, regulatory and shareholder approvals, and financing. SEALSQ will contribute selected assets from its SealQuantum.com portfolio. Watch for execution of definitive agreements and completion risk; the non-binding nature and multi-party structure add complexity.
